blocks.name: The Alkanes
blocks.definition:
know the general formula for alkanes
explain why alkanes are classified as saturated hydrocarbons
understand how to draw the structural and displayed formulae for alkanes with up to five carbon atoms in the molecule, and to name the unbranched-chain isomers

blocks.md:
- Alkanes are a group of **saturated** hydrocarbons
- The term saturated means that they only have single carbon-carbon bonds, there are no double bonds
- The [general formula](https://www.savemyexams.com/igcse/chemistry/edexcel/19/revision-notes/4-organic-chemistry/4-1-introduction/4-1-1-organic-compounds/) of the alkanes is **C**<sub>**n**</sub>**H**<sub>**2n+2**</sub>
- Alkanes are generally unreactive compounds but they do undergo **combustion** reactions, can be **cracked** into smaller molecules and can react with **halogens** in the presence of light
- Methane is an alkane and is the major component of **natural** **gas**
